title: free-disk-space component diagram
description: The crate and the third-party crates compiled into its binary. What the binary reaches at run time (the state file, macOS tools, launchd, Docker) is drawn in src's diagram.

components.name: free-disk-space source
components.responsibility: The binary's modules: command line, scan, compression, dedupe, cleanup, daemon and helpers.

components.name: clap
components.responsibility: Parses the subcommands and flags from derive attributes, and prints help and version.

components.name: rusqlite (bundled SQLite)
components.responsibility: Opens and queries the scan state file; the bundled feature compiles SQLite into the binary.

components.name: flate2
components.responsibility: zlib-compresses file samples to estimate how well a file would compress.

components.name: sha2
components.responsibility: SHA-256 of files, to verify compressed copies and clones and to find identical files.

components.name: ctrlc
components.responsibility: Turns Ctrl-C, and with the termination feature SIGTERM, into the graceful stop flag.

components.name: chrono
components.responsibility: Local timestamps for the daemon's log and the date clean prints for the start of today.

components.name: serde_json
components.responsibility: The JSON values in the state file's meta table.

components.name: libc
components.responsibility: System calls the standard library does not offer: statvfs, clock_gettime, access, utimensat, ioctl, getuid.

relationships.description: src/main.rs is the binary's entry point.
main.rs derives Parser, Subcommand, Args and ValueEnum.
scan.rs, compress.rs and dedupe.rs read and write the state file.
